title: EmailVerificationRequestedIntegrationEvent
description: Published by Auth from the request and resend verification commands; consumed by Notification (sends the verify-email e-mail). Contract source: backend/c#/OmniCore.Services.Auth/OmniCore.Services.Auth.Contracts/Events/EmailVerificationRequestedIntegrationEvent.cs.

Username.description: Used as the display name in the mail.

Token.description: Secret: the raw single-use verification code. Only its SHA-256 is stored; consumers must not log it.
